question: By what principle will the ruler protect the entire kingdom addressed to the goddess?
premises: The entire kingdom is the object of protection.
Protection will be carried out according to dharma.
inference: He will protect the entire kingdom according to dharma.
uncertainties: The subject of pālayiṣyati is implied from context rather than named in this verse.
plain_english: O goddess, he will protect that entire kingdom according to dharma.
